class.name: RealtimeGIData
class.brief_description: Contains what a [RealtimeGI] bake works out about a scene.
class.description: [RealtimeGIData] holds a [RealtimeGI] bake: the patches its static surfaces were cut into and their lightmap atlas, how light travels between the patches and from the sky, the geometry lights cast shadows with, and the probes that light dynamic objects. None of it depends on the lights, which is why they can move. A new bake replaces it.

method.name: clear_users
method.description: Forgets the meshes this bake lights, and the copies with UV2 it made for them.

method.name: get_atlas_size
method.description: Returns the size in texels of the lightmap realtime GI writes, one texel per patch.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the bounds of the patches, in the [RealtimeGI]'s space.

method.name: get_cluster_count
method.description: Returns how many clusters the patches are grouped in. Light reaching a patch is gathered from clusters rather than from single patches.

method.name: get_generated_mesh_count
method.description: Returns how many meshes were given UV2 by the bake. See [member RealtimeGI.generate_uv2].

method.name: get_patch_count
method.description: Returns how many patches the static surfaces were cut into.

method.name: get_patch_size
method.description: Returns the patch size the bake used. It is larger than [member RealtimeGI.patch_size] when the scene was too large for a 4096×4096 atlas at that size.

method.name: get_probe_count
method.description: Returns how many probes light dynamic objects.

method.name: get_transport_entry_count
method.description: Returns how many patch-to-cluster links the transport holds, four bytes each.

method.name: get_triangle_count
method.description: Returns how many triangles cast shadows for realtime GI. Meshes with LODs give a simplified version.

method.name: get_user_count
method.description: Returns how many meshes this bake lights.

method.name: get_user_path
method.description: Returns the path, from the [RealtimeGI], of a mesh this bake lights.
